coordinate_space: Existing face transform only; no new face or costume. Numbers are small creative targets for Code to adapt to current bounded transforms, not runtime acceptance.

pet_squish.while_contact: Ease towards scaleX1.15/scaleY.83 (bounded), tiny +/-2deg wobble only as finger moves. Preserve rounded white eyes and tiny mouth.
pet_squish.sound: Choose press OR spring-release as the single sound for this gesture, not both.

finger_follow.behavior: Keep existing gaze tracking for finger on/around Buddy; allow small whole-face lean within existing safe bounds on the follow variant. Do not silently replace petting with follow-only. Give both predictable access (tap vs pet/drag or existing gesture routing).
finger_follow.sound: At most ONE short nonrepeating alternative for gesture; visual tracking can stay continuous without audio.

car_reaction_ideas.instruction: Support Mike four tilt mappings in existing prototype, not real-acceleration claims. Reuse canonical face, bounded eased blend .12-.20s and neutral return .30s. No new engine audio/long scene lock required for these continuous reactive poses. Code owns actual sensor calibration and mapping.

policy: These are responsive micro-animations, NOT full costume scenes. No seven-second input lock. Release/cancel/hidden restores neutral. Preserve reduced-motion/static reactions and mute. Existing full-scene lock remains unchanged; do not let reactive input interrupt finite costume scenes.
